introHtml: Neoprene keychains offer a soft, flexible feel that sets them apart from rigid plastic or metal options. The material absorbs screen printing and sublimation well, making it a strong choice for detailed logos or full-color designs. Marketing directors often choose neoprene for trade show giveaways because the fabric is gentle on device screens when used as a card holder. Safety managers appreciate the lightweight, non-scratch properties for lanyard attachments. Whether you need a wrist strap or a card guard, neoprene provides a comfortable, durable surface that keeps your brand visible.
heroAltText: Custom neoprene keychains in various colors with printed logos, including card guards and wrist strap holders.
